description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Text class, which specifies a module for handling XHTML 1.1 text elements within the HTML Purifier library. It sets up various inline, block, heading, and structural elements for text processing and sanitization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Text
classes.description: A class representing the XHTML 1.1 Text Module for HTML Purifier, defining text-related HTML elements and their configuration.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the module by adding various text-related elements (e.g., inline, block, heading, structural) to the purifier's configuration, including setting properties like formatting and excludes.
